card.name: Inside new drug generic names
card.fires_on: Middle pieces of newly approved drug generic names, such as conc-iz-umab, oz-anim-od, laz-ert-inib, when the name is split into parts. Seen in dosing, interaction and clinical pharmacology text.

modes.label: Small-molecule names
modes.description: Middle piece of a newer drug name ending in -inib, -pant, -stat or similar.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words about therapies and promising treatment, and away from unrelated name pieces.
